title: Google Research ETCModel: Fused Global-Local Attention & Clipped Relative Position Encoding for Structured Long Contexts
author: repo-triad-forge

edges.description: Subproject etcmodel in snapshot google-research-master (archive snapshot, non-git); EMNLP 2020 / arXiv:2004.08483

claims.assertion: FusedGlobalLocalAttention fuses long-to-long (l2l) and long-to-global (l2g) attention under one softmax and global-to-global (g2g) + global-to-long (g2l) under a second softmax, recovering standard Transformer attention when local_radius covers the full sequence and projections are shared.

RelativePositionGenerator computes clipped relative_att_ids with relative_vocab_size = 2 * max_distance + 1 (directional) or max_distance + 1 (symmetric via ignore_direction=True) using a tiled shifted pattern tensor.

distilled_learning: Fuse global summary tokens and bounded-radius local tokens under joint attention softmaxes (l2l+l2g, g2g+g2l) with clipped relative positions to encode long hierarchical contexts without quadratic attention cost.
